_comment: Reviewed company catalog. Every entry needs slug, name, domains and category. A grievance contact is either an email (email, source_url, verified_on) or a web form (channel web_form, form_url, source_url, verified_on); source_url is the company's published privacy or grievance page, and a contact is added only after a person checked it against that page. self_serve_url is the company's own account-deletion page, optional. Fictional entries use example.com, carry fictional: true and are loaded outside production only. Real contacts and links are added by hand from each company's own page, in this file or in catalog.local.json (not committed).
